description: Search a repository's wiki pages for a plain-text query, matched case-insensitively on each page's title and on each line of its body. Returns {hits, pages_scanned, pages_skipped, truncated}; a hit is {page_name, line, snippet} and a title match has no line. The search reads at most 100 pages and returns at most 20 hits, and a page over 1 MiB is skipped and counted in pages_skipped. truncated true means a cap stopped the search, so no hits does not prove absence. Pass a hit's page_name to get_wiki_page, with its line as start_line.

query.description: Plain text to find, matched case-insensitively; not a pattern

name: search_wiki
